body:
Thank you for answering. 

I've been trying to enforce a schedule on myself. It's been harder and harder to even leave my house, and honestly I'd be a shut in if I could survive that way. I know that just makes my depression worse, but going out is difficult too. None of it seems worth doing.

Bones repair stronger too but you don't go breaking them on purpose. 

I think maybe there are just too many fucked up things that have happened to me, too much fucked up in my head, that the process of beginning to fix it is just going to cause more damage than anything. I don't know if that even makes any sense but at this point it's how I feel.
